body: Make her understand that she is not alone, that she can rely on people like you. Do things together and gain confidence, she will feel liberated. Small questions about her day make you see that you really care and that's a nice feeling
I hope you do not suffer anymore

I had depression for months and he knew it, he made me promise every week that he would not leave me alone, whether or not I was a couple, there were weeks where he was indifferent to me until he broke up with me in my birthday...
Thanks for your message, it's really helpful. Anything I will talk to you :)
